name: Supplies
operation_language: Authoring declarations only; not registered engine opcodes.

authored_operations.requirement: Track actual food pounds, water gallons, capacity, contamination, intake, size-based daily requirements, expiry/spoilage and remaining stock. Consume exact copies/quantities once; magical nourishment and no-eating/drinking exceptions keep their specific scope. Apply the full dehydration/malnutrition Exhaustion and recovery restrictions at actual deadlines.

blockers: Food servings and magical spring potion flavor do not establish pounds/gallons or infinite refill. Production survival size lookup and each projected form/created actor need reconciliation with actual effective size and exception sources. Keep legacy nourishment deadlines distinct from physical intake.
reuse_boundary: Existing accepted pieces remain accepted at their documented limits; these requirements do not mark the entire slices missing.

source_parameters.authority: SRD 5.2.1 pp.181,185; source-specific spell/character exceptions still apply
source_parameters.dehydration: Less than half required water: 1 Exhaustion at day end. Exhaustion caused by dehydration cannot be removed until full daily amount is drunk.
source_parameters.malnutrition: Eating but less than half required food: CON save DC10 or 1 Exhaustion at day end. No food for 5 days: 1 Exhaustion at end of day 5 and each subsequent foodless day. Malnutrition Exhaustion cannot be removed until full daily amount is eaten.
source_parameters.measurement_blocker: food_servings are not automatically pounds. Temporary size/form and no-eating/drinking sources must bind to actual consumers; no extra daily stock is created.
